messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout 15% -> v2.0.0-beta (region split: 10% NA, 5% APAC). Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Release notes: https://go/release/2.0.0-beta :sparkles:

anna_releng: kickoff OK, heatup scheduled. tagging @kevin_sre for APAC telemetry watch.

kevin_sre: APAC p50 fine but seeing increase in 502s from edge proxies for the 5% cohort. small spike around +30s after shift. tail traces show upstream disconnects.

josh_infra: infra: some APAC nodes hitting connection resets to model shard pool. suspect new connection pooling behavior in v2 runtime. autoscale didn't mask it yet.

nina_prod: user-facing errors? any org-level SLO impacts?

kevin_sre: customer-visible 502s ~0.3% for APAC cohort. NA cohort looks clean. Recommend pause APAC ramp and pin NA at 10%.

anna_releng: proposal: 
1) STOP APAC increase, pin APAC traffic at 5% (no further expansion),
2) route APAC canary to fallback variant v1.13.9-edge while we triage,
3) leave NA progressing to 25% after hold period if NA stable.

ops_lead: quick vote: STOP APAC ramp and pin. Allow NA to continue ramp to 25% in 15m if no regressions. Vote: stop(apac)/go(na). :ballot_box_with_check:

deploy-bot: Action: traffic.update applied at 1748601272. APAC cohort pinned at 5%, routing freeze engaged. NA cohort incremental ramp schedule remains, next shift in 15m. Link: https://go/deploy/ops/1748601272

josh_infra: I'll prepare fallback routing for APAC: `route --to v1.13.9-edge --regions=ap-south,ap-northeast --cohort=canary` Ready to execute on approval.

kevin_sre: run fallback routing and then watch for 10m. If 502s drop back to baseline, we can unfreeze APAC and rework connection pooling in staging.

anna_releng: approved. @deploy-bot, run josh_infra's fallback route and notify when done. I'll update release notes with latency/502 note and tag incident if persistence.

deploy-bot: Executing route change for APAC canary -> v1.13.9-edge. Step 1/2: drain 2% -> 0 over 40s, Step 2/2: attach 5% -> fallback. Monitoring hooks enabled (p95, error-rate, 502-rate). ETA ~2m.

ops_lead: creating incident: INC-2024-4827. Scheduling 30m follow-up. Tagging oncall and infra. Attach traces and sample requests to ticket.

kevin_sre: post-change: APAC 502s dropped to baseline in 3m. no customer escalations. marking as mitigated for now.

anna_releng: thanks. We'll keep NA ramp observable. If NA shows similar issues, we'll abort and rollback. Otherwise we'll continue scheduled ramping. Keeping thread as single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
